_meta.note: Pilot set of 12 brands. Every URL below was fetched with curl -sL (normal browser user-agent, redirects followed), returned HTTP 200, and the page text was grepped for the claim recorded in `supports`. Final URL after redirects is what is stored. Company self-reporting is labelled source_type=company_report and is_primary=1.

patagonia.title: Patagonia — Fair Labor Association member page
patagonia.supports: Patagonia is listed as a member of the Fair Labor Association, the independent multi-stakeholder body that audits factories against its Workplace Code of Conduct.

nudie-jeans.title: Nudie Jeans Sustainability Report 2025
nudie-jeans.supports: Nudie Jeans publishes an annual sustainability report; the 2025 edition sets out its regenerative organic cotton work and other climate measures.

nudie-jeans.title: This is Nudie Jeans — About
nudie-jeans.supports: Nudie Jeans states that jeans are designed to be repaired rather than replaced and that it has been repairing jeans since 2007.

dr-bronners.title: Dr. Bronner's — Who We Are
dr-bronners.supports: Dr. Bronner's states its soaps are made with organic and Fair Trade ingredients and are third-party certified to industry standards.

dr-bronners.title: Dr. Bronner's — Product certifications
dr-bronners.supports: Lists its third-party certifications, including Fair for Life fair-trade certification for its main ingredients and Regenerative Organic Certified oils.

dr-bronners.title: Dr. Bronner's — Reducing waste generation
dr-bronners.supports: Describes its waste programme: a target of one dumpster a month to landfill, on-site waste-sorting stations, and 100% post-consumer recycled shipping cartons.

dr-bronners.title: Dr. Bronner's — Regenerative organic agriculture & environment
dr-bronners.supports: Explains its work with the Regenerative Organic Alliance on soil health, animal welfare and farmworker fairness, and its view of agriculture's climate impact.

ethique.title: Ethique — Better for the planet
ethique.supports: Ethique reports 100% carbon-neutral production, offsets of 120% of production emissions, and that only 0.07% of 2024 shipments went by air.

ethique.title: Ethique — Impact
ethique.supports: Ethique publishes its running count of plastic bottles saved and describes its plastic-free, waterless solid-bar model.

blueland.title: Blueland — Our certifications
blueland.supports: Blueland lists the third-party certifications it holds, including Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, Leaping Bunny and a B Corp score of 110.

blueland.title: Blueland — Our mission & impact
blueland.supports: Blueland reports more than 1 billion single-use plastic bottles diverted and 7.5 million+ pounds of CO2 saved, and links its annual impact reports.

who-gives-a-crap.title: Who Gives A Crap — Our global impact
who-gives-a-crap.supports: Who Gives A Crap states its products are made from recycled fibres or FSC-certified bamboo — never virgin trees — and publishes a No Deforestation Commitment.

who-gives-a-crap.title: Who Gives A Crap — Our global impact (carbon footprint)
who-gives-a-crap.supports: The same impact page reports a full life-cycle analysis of its carbon footprint, carbon-neutral shipping via Pachama offsets, and warehouse solar panels.

vaude.title: VAUDE — Global supply chain
vaude.supports: VAUDE states it has been a Fair Wear member since 2010 and has been rated 'Leader' in Fair Wear's Brand Performance Check every year since 2015.

vaude.title: VAUDE — Green Shape products
vaude.supports: VAUDE describes Green Shape® as its environmental standard for outdoor textiles, assessed across the whole product life cycle from design to end of life.

vaude.title: VAUDE — Commitment to protecting biodiversity
vaude.supports: VAUDE sets out its biodiversity commitments and the species-loss evidence behind them.

back-market.title: Back Market — About us
back-market.supports: Back Market describes its model as extending the life of devices and fighting electronic waste, with commitments to e-waste management partnerships.

back-market.title: Back Market — About us (impact metrics)
back-market.supports: The same page reports metric tons of CO2e prevented and publishes its B Corp score as its headline impact measures.

beautycounter.title: Counter (BeautyCounter) — The Standard
beautycounter.supports: Counter sets out its 'Blueprint for Clean' ingredient-screening standard and explains why it treats regulatory baselines as a floor rather than a standard.

beautycounter.title: Counter (BeautyCounter) — Ingredient list / The Never List
beautycounter.supports: Lists the 'Never List' of ingredients Counter excludes from all products, with the stated reason for each (e.g. parabens, certain UV filters).

meliora.title: Meliora — Sustainability
meliora.supports: Meliora lists the certifications its products and company hold, including Certified B Corporation and WBENC woman-owned certification.

meliora.title: Meliora — 2025 Sustainability Report
meliora.supports: Meliora's 2025 sustainability report publishes its impact numbers, including plastic avoided, local sourcing, GHG emissions and water waste avoided.

meliora.title: Meliora — Certified B Corporation
meliora.supports: Meliora's own page explaining its B Corp certification and what the assessment covers.

apple.title: Apple — Environment
apple.supports: Apple states that Apple 2030 aims to cut greenhouse gas emissions 75% against 2015 and become carbon neutral across its global footprint.

apple.title: Apple — Supply chain innovation
apple.supports: Apple reports that 33M+ supplier employees have been trained on workplace rights since 2008 and describes its supplier-code monitoring.

samsung.title: Samsung Electronics — Climate action
samsung.supports: Samsung sets out plans to cut direct greenhouse gas emissions, shift to renewable energy and decarbonise its value chain.

samsung.title: Samsung Electronics — Circular economy
samsung.supports: Samsung commits to using recycled plastic in all plastic parts of DX products by 2050 and to an e-waste collection system in all global sales regions by 2030.

samsung.title: Samsung Electronics — Clean tech innovation & people
samsung.supports: Samsung's sustainability hub covers its human rights commitment, health and safety and supply-chain management approach.
